description: This file contains unit tests for the RootRoute class in the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It tests various HTTP endpoints, including health checks, status, thing retrieval, search, WebSocket upgrades, and error scenarios, validating security restrictions and correct responses.

classes.name: RootRouteTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the RootRoute class, validating route responses to various requests and security behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including route setup with mocks and dependencies.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Tests that accessing the root path returns 404 Not Found.

methods.name: getHealthWithoutAuthReturnsOK
methods.description: Tests that the /health endpoint returns 200 OK without authentication.

methods.name: getStatusWithAuth
methods.description: Tests that /status endpoint responds successfully with valid auth.

methods.name: getStatusWithoutAuth
methods.description: Ensures that /status endpoint without authentication returns 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: getStatusUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Checks that accessing the status URL without HTTPS results in 404.

methods.name: getStatusHealth
methods.description: Verifies that /status/health responds successfully.

methods.name: getStatusHealthWithoutHttps
methods.description: Ensures /status/health without HTTPS returns 404.

methods.name: getStatusCluster
methods.description: Verifies /status/cluster endpoint response.

methods.name: getStatusClusterWithoutHttps
methods.description: Checks that /status/cluster without HTTPS returns 404.

methods.name: getThingWithVeryLongId
methods.description: Tests handling of very long thing IDs, expecting BAD_REQUEST with specific error.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithoutIds
methods.description: Tests that /things endpoint without IDs returns BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIds
methods.description: Checks successful response for valid /things with IDs.

methods.name: getThings1UrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Validates /things API version 1 is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getThings2UrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Validates /things API version 2 is not accessible without HTTPS.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIdsWithWrongVersionNumber
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid version number in /things URL.

methods.name: getThingsUrlWithIdsWithNonExistingVersionNumber
methods.description: Tests handling of non-existent version number in /things URL.

methods.name: getThingWithResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Tests response when response-required header is false, expecting BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: getThingSearchUrl
methods.description: Verifies successful search route response.

methods.name: getWhoamiUrl
methods.description: Verifies /whoami endpoint response.

methods.name: getNonExistingSearchUrl
methods.description: Checks that non-existent search URL returns 404.

methods.name: getWsUrlWithoutUpgrade
methods.description: Validates WebSocket URL without upgrade headers returns correct response.

methods.name: getWsUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Validates WebSocket URL without HTTPS returns 404.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrl
methods.description: Checks that unknown top-level URL returns 404.

methods.name: getNonExistingToplevelUrlWithoutHttps
methods.description: Checks redirection for non-HTTPS request to unknown URL.

methods.name: getExceptionForDuplicateHeaderFields
methods.description: Verifies BAD_REQUEST response for duplicate headers.

methods.name: getExceptionForDuplicationHeaderAndQueryParameter
methods.description: Verifies BAD_REQUEST when header and query parameter diverge.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToTooManyAuthSubjects
methods.description: Tests handling of too many authentication subjects, expecting Too Large response.

methods.name: acceptMaximumNumberOfAuthSubjects
methods.description: Tests boundary condition for maximum allowed auth subjects.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToLargeHeaders
methods.description: Ensures headers exceeding size limit produce REQUEST_HEADER_FIELDS_TOO_LARGE.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToInvalidHeaderKey
methods.description: Ensures invalid header key throws IllegalHeaderException.

methods.name: getExceptionDueToInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Ensures invalid header value throws IllegalHeaderException.
